names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 10023, «Петр (Панков), мч.», with the rank word after the comma left off. The day’s own line gives the name without the surname, so the surname is read off the name link, where the calendar prints it, and it is part of the name and stays. Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'панков петр' has no other holder in the corpus, where the bare «Петр» is a fold eleven folders wide — which is BRIEF-RUSSIAN §2’s own example of why the surname is kept.

death.note: The year the day line prints for the three of them: «Сщмч. Иоанна пресвитера и чад его мчч. Николая и Петра (1918).» No year of birth appears on the name page, which is all the calendar gives him, and none was inferred.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 апреля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Иоанна пресвитера и чад его мчч. Николая и Петра (1918).»

attestations.note: The third person of the day’s fifth entry, ONE LINE NAMING THREE: the other two are `john-pankov`, the priest the line calls his father, and `nicholas-pankov`, separate folders of this batch. THE RELATION IS THE LINE’S OWN WORD, «чад его», his children. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: page 10023 prints the title «Петр (Панков), мч.» and «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 26 апреля» and nothing else. What it gives that the line does not is the surname «Панков». He is graded «мч.», martyr, with no clerical rank anywhere, so no `office` was written; 26 января is the general commemoration of the new martyrs and confessors, which is how `new-martyr` is read into `types`, and THAT DAY PAGE WAS NOT READ. NO FOLDER WAS FOUND FOR HIM: `grep -rl 'Панков'` over `saints/` returns nothing and the gate’s own key function returns no holder for 'панков петр' or 'pankov peter'. The day page prints five hymns and none under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.
